key_insight: This colorectal cancer dataset captures source-linked specialist reasoning and tumour-board decisions, rather than AI cancer drug discovery.
clinical_relevance: It provides a research resource for studying how specialists interpret evidence, resolve disagreements, and formulate multidisciplinary management strategies.
method: Three experienced oncology specialists independently linked clinical source text to interpretations, uncertainties, and proposed strategies.
After records were locked, an LLM generated candidate discussion questions for tumour-board chair review.
Four physicians discussed each case; two medical residents verified automatically generated transcripts.
evidence_signal: Ten retrospectively selected cases yielded 30 specialist reasoning records, 10 verified discussion transcripts, and 10 final tumour-board decisions with provenance and quality-control metadata.
watch_item: The small, retrospective dataset does not establish generalizability or demonstrate improved clinical outcomes from AI support.
paper_title: Source-linked multispecialty clinical reasoning and tumour-board decision-making in colorectal cancer
